liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bird Song** (3 reviews): Described as potentially one of the best versions of the song ever recorded; Described as downright disgusting, one of the reviewer's favorite performances of the song [32][37][39]
- **Knockin' On Heaven's Door** (2 reviews): Might be the best version of the song ever recorded; Reviewer's favorite version, noting Jerry's emotional voice makes you cry [34][37]
- **Eyes of the World** (1 review): Described as legendary, possibly from the Without a Net album [40]
- **Throwing Stones** (1 review): Described as the best version of the song the reviewer has heard [36]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-03-29.127385.mtx.eichorn.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 158 min; rated 5/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd1990-03-29.mtx.hansokolow.97118.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 18 songs; 158 min; rated 4.75/5 by 8 [2]
- **gd1990-03-29.nak300.andrewf.83612.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 157 min; rated 5/5 by 4 [3]
- **gd1990-03-29.AKG451.Berger.Currier.Keo.121843.Flac1644**: source not stated; 18 songs; 163 min [4]
- **gd90-03-29.sbd.hinko.24996.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 152 min; rated 4.88/5 by 16 [16]. Said about its sound: Sound quality rated five out of five, described as totally smokin; This copy is superior in quality to the other two versions on the site; The show is fluid, flowing with life and intensity, leaving room for improvisation [32][35][36]
- **gd90-03-29.sbd.miller.26341.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 151 min; rated 4.45/5 by 29 [18]. Said about its sound: Described as Jazz Dead, with Dark Star being psychedelic jazz [41]
- **gd90-03-29.aud-fob.set2.unknown.1317.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 9 songs; 104 min; rated 4.53/5 by 34 [29]. Said about its sound: Lacks expected crowd noise, suggesting a matrix source rather than a Schoeps FOB [30]

## Around the show

- Marsalis adds an abstract edge to the performance of Knockin' On Heaven's Door [34]
- Branford Marsalis adds flair, with the second set described as being on fire [37]
- Branford Marsalis plays on Birdsong and the entire second set [3]
- Branford Marsalis plays saxophones on Bird Song, Promised Land, and the second set [4]
- Considered superior to the Healy 24-track mixdown due to better Phil and audience energy [31]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-03-29.127385.mtx.eichorn.flac16**: taped by Roger Eichorn; transferred by Roger Eichorn; source: Matrix from SBD (shnid=33925) and AUD (shnid=91347) [1]. Also: Recorded and transferred by Keith Litzenberger using Sennheiser ME-80s and Technics SV-MD1 DAT [1]
- **gd1990-03-29.mtx.hansokolow.97118.flac16**: transferred by hansokolow; source: matrix of DSBD: shnid=????? and DAUD: shnid=91347 by hansokolow using ProTools [2]. Also: Matrix done by hansokolow in ProTools, transferred from DAT master in Flying Gonz studios [2]
- **gd1990-03-29.nak300.andrewf.83612.flac16**: taped by Andrew F; transferred by Andrew F.; source: Nakamichi CM300's with CP4 shotgun capsules > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX-90's, with Dolby off. Mics on stand aprx 7-feet high, pointed at stacks, set up in… [3]. Also: Tape flips in Birdsong and Dark Star patched using first-gen cassette and ShnID-1317 [3]
- **gd1990-03-29.AKG451.Berger.Currier.Keo.121843.Flac1644**: taped by B.R. And Mr. Currier; transferred by Rob Berger and Keo; source: Recorded By B.R. And Mr. Currier Recorded From The OTS; AKG451 With Shotguns>AKG 9V Phantom Power Box>Sony TCD-D10 (Rob Berger's)> Sony TCD-D10>(B.R.'s Patch);… [4]. Also: Copies sent from B.R.'s original master DAT and Mr. Berger's initial setup [4]
- **gd90-03-29.sbd.hinko.24996.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Darryl Hinko; source: Soundboard (Hinko) [16]
- **gd90-03-29.sbd.miller.26341.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard (Miller) [18]
- **gd90-03-29.aud-fob.set2.unknown.1317.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience (matrix??) [29]
